🔢
STD (Standard Transaction) Formula: CASE
  WHEN NOT REGEXP_MATCH(type, '(?i).V.|.R.|.X.')
  THEN CONCAT(store_code, receipt_number, cashier_code, CAST(tr_date AS TEXT))
  ELSE NULL
END
STD counts only valid forward transactions — the composite key store+receipt+cashier+date is generated only when the transaction type does not match the pattern (?i).V.|.R.|.X. — i.e. excludes Void, Return, Exchange, Refund, and any reversal-type transaction. The distinct count of non-null keys = STD. Avg Basket (STD) = Net Sales ÷ STD is more accurate than raw Avg Basket because it excludes the distorting effect of void/return bills.

💰 Promo ROI & Incremental Impact
💡
Incremental = penjualan tambahan di atas baseline (unit yang tetap laku tanpa promo). Discount Investment = uang yang "dilepas" karena diskon (harga normal − harga promo) × qty promo. ROI = margin incremental ÷ discount investment. ROI > 100% = promo menghasilkan margin lebih besar dari biaya diskonnya.

Price Elasticity & ROI
Promotion impact on sales volume, GM & Return on Investment
Metodologi: The data distinguishes type=L (Loyalty/Promo) vs type=N (Normal/Non-Promo). Volume Uplift = the difference in average qty per transaction between the promo period (L) and non-promo (N) for the same SKU. Incremental GM = promo-period GM − normal-period GM. ROI = Incremental Net Sales ÷ COGS Promo × 100%. Price Elasticity = % change qty ÷ % change price (only for SKUs with an L vs N price difference, n=79 SKU).

Decision Quadrant — Uplift × Margin Impact

🔮 Sales Forecasting
Next-month sales forecast based on Jan–May 2026 history
3 Forecasting Methods: Linear Trend = linear regression Y=a+bX · good for a consistent up/down trend. Moving Average (MA3) = average of the last 3 months · smooth, ignores outliers. Weighted MA = recent months weighted higher (40%/30%/20%/10%) · more responsive. Confidence Interval 95% = upper/lower prediction range based on historical std error.

🏷 Breakdown Diskon Promo
Sebaran promo menurut %diskon, nominal diskon, dan range harga promo yang paling banyak dibeli konsumen
⚠️
Breakdown by %Diskon
Diskon = (harga normal − harga promo) ÷ harga normal. Tiap PLU masuk satu band.
Band %Diskon# PLUQty Terjual Net Sales% Qty% Net SalesAvg Diskon
Breakdown by Nominal Diskon (Tk)
Nominal diskon per unit = harga normal − harga promo.

🎁 Promo Mechanic — Direct Cut vs Free Gift
Membandingkan efektivitas tiap mekanisme promo dari kolom Promo Type di Juklak
⚠️
💡
Bandingkan unit per SKU (rata-rata daya jual tiap item) dengan biaya diskon tiap mekanisme. Mekanisme dengan daya jual tinggi namun biaya rendah adalah yang paling efisien untuk kategori tersebut. Catatan: ini bukan uplift terhadap baseline — untuk uplift sesungguhnya lihat halaman Promo Effectiveness.

📊 SKU Pareto Analysis (80/20 Rule)
Which SKUs drive 80% of revenue? Data-driven assortment optimisation
Prinsip Pareto (80/20): ~20% SKU menghasilkan 80% revenue. Tier A (0–80%) = hero products · Tier B (80–95%) = supporting · Tier C (95–100%) = long tail — evaluasi delist

🚨 Member Churn Risk Analysis
Identify members at risk of churn before they leave — act before it's too late
Churn Score (0–100): Recency Score (months inactive × 20, max 60) + Frequency Drop Score (penurunan frekuensi kunjungan × 0.35, max 35). ≥60 = CRITICAL · 40–59 = HIGH · 20–39 = MEDIUM · <20 = LOW
🔴 Critical
—
≥2 months inactive
🟠 High Risk
—
1 month, freq drop >50%
🔵 Medium Risk
—
1 month inactive
🟢 Low Risk
—
Aktif & frekuensi stabil
Churn Risk Distribution
Members per risk level
Churn Score Distribution

How to Use
1. Upload file dataOne or more data sources above
2. Supported formats.xlsx · .xls · .csv — no partials needed, upload the complete file at once
3. Row capacity100,000+ rows supported — SheetJS (xlsx) + PapaParse streaming
4. Klik "Rebuild Dashboard"The dashboard automatically recomputes all KPIs and charts
5. Monthly updateUpload the new month’s file; old data is replaced automatically
Column namesFlexible — many column-name variations are auto-detected
Built-in dataThe dashboard shows the Jan–Mar 2026 sample when no file is uploaded
